items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: in fact Sam McDaniel used to work with my father.

ctx.x: The music that was played in your house off the records, was it a combination of things?

Yes. Because my aunt loved Duke Ellington, and of course we loved Nat King Cole and it’s very interesting too, because I have a cousin now that I see often. In those days some of the families frowned on jazz, as some of them still do unfortunately. It’s very, very sad to know that they made these wonderful contributions and people would call it the devil’s music. But I was blessed in that. I didn’t come up in that kind of environment. And I had a Christian home, but my aunt, Mrs. Hightower, who had been in…
And your aunt taught in the public school system?
